violation_type.title: Tummy Time Activities - Ensure that caregivers and staff can see and hear the infant when an infant is engaged in tummy time (26 TAC §747.2318(1))
violation_type.short_title: Tummy Time Activities - Ensure that caregivers and staff can see and hear the infant when an infant is engaged in tummy time
violation_type.typical_finding: A six month old infant was observed doing tummy time while not being visible to the caregiver.
